description: Update an existing stage. Provide the stage id and any fields to change. Set pipeline_id to move the stage to another pipeline.

days_to_rotten.description: Days until a deal not updated in this stage becomes rotten (applies only when is_deal_rot_enabled is set; null to clear)

deal_probability.description: The success probability percentage of deals in this stage (0-100)

id.description: The ID of the stage to update

is_deal_rot_enabled.description: Whether deals in this stage can become rotten

name.description: The new name of the stage

pipeline_id.description: Move the stage to this pipeline ID

name: pipedrive_update_stage
